scope: observed command catalogue, not capability or creative acceptance

commands.label: Delete Render Files In to Out
Add Range Marker to In and Out
Ripple Trim Previous Edit to Playhead
Ripple Trim Next Edit to Playhead
Edit Text
commands.params: {"clip":id?,"layer":n|name?,"text":str,"merge":bool? (coalesce with the previous Edit Text undo step)}

commands.label: Align Layers
commands.params: {"clip":id?,"layers":[n]?,"align":"left|hcenter|right|top|vcenter|bottom","to":"frame|group|selection"="frame" (frame: each layer; group: the layers' union; one layer always aligns to the frame)}

commands.label: Distribute Layers
commands.params: {"clip":id?,"layers":[n] (3 or more)?,"axis":"horizontal|vertical","space":bool=false (equal gaps instead of equal centre spacing)}

commands.label: From file…
commands.params: {"path":str,"time":ticks?,"track":index?} (imports the image or video and places it above the clips at the playhead)

commands.label: Reset Duration
commands.params: {"clip":id?,"seconds":f64=5 (the default graphic duration; limited by the next clip on the track)}

commands.label: Export As Motion Graphics Template…
commands.params: {"clip":id?,"name":str,"category":str="My Templates","description":str?,"controls":[{"layer":n|name,"param":"text|fill_color|size|font|position|enabled|…","name":str?,"kind":"text|color|slider|checkbox|font|position"?,"min":f64?,"max":f64?,"id":str?}]? (default: each text layer's text),"path":str? (default: the user templates folder),"embedFonts":bool=false,"fontLicense":str?}

commands.label: Graphics Template Thumbnail
commands.params: {"template":id|name|path,"width":px=320,"path":str? (write a PNG there; else returned as pngBase64)}

commands.label: Responsive Design - Time
commands.params: {"clip":id?,"introFrames":n?,"outroFrames":n? (or introSeconds / outroSeconds, or ticks as intro / outro)}

commands.label: Character Style
commands.params: {"clip":id?,"layer":n|name?,"start":char=0,"end":char=len,"style":{"font":str,"fontStyle":str,"size":px,"color":"#rrggbb","bold":bool,"italic":bool,"underline":bool,"tracking":n,"baselineShift":px,"caps":"normal|all caps|small caps"},"clear":bool? (remove styles from the range)}

commands.label: Upgrade Caption to Graphic
commands.params: {"captions":[id]? (default: the selected captions, else the one under the playhead)}

commands.label: Link Media…
commands.params: {}  (opens the Link Media dialog; agents use media.relink / media.autoRelink)

commands.label: Offline All
commands.params: {}  (leave every missing file offline and close the Link Media dialog)
